1363285.title: Brimstone Terrace

1377237.title: Runner

1392469.title: Cocktail 2

1397909.title: Honeyjoon

Amidst honeymooners, the Woman, Life, Freedom movement and their hot, philosophical tour guide, João, the pair find each other… coming back to life.

1399253.title: Our Secret

Caught between memories and nightmares, and unable to express what they feel to each other, a mother and her children shield themselves from the pain of grief through their individual routines. Only the youngest child understands the secret that the house holds within its four walls and tries to reveal it to the others, only to fall on deaf ears. Finally, confronted with the truth, they face the deep roots of their grief and come together to traverse this moment with love and courage.

1405205.title: The Riverbank

1418901.title: Mother's Pride

1423253.title: Korean Kanakaraju

1426965.title: Phantoms of July

But an unfortunate breakdown leads the family to a scrapyard on the outskirts of a deserted inland town, where they come upon its owners, Alicia and Miguel.

1474133.title: The Tao Exorcist

1484181.title: The Smell of Apples

1492501.title: Being Towards Death

1496021.title: The making of "The Kaptain: The story of Francesco Silvestre"
1496021.overview: The story behind the production of "Il Kapitano: Una dedica a Francesco Silvestre" (2025)

1550357.trailerName: Di Balik Sifat Kerasnya Tante Meriam Bellina | Official Trailer Titip Bunda di Surga-Mu

1554709.title: Racism In A*t
1554709.overview: When an organization that hunts prejudice in art finds its next target, silence is no longer an option.

1559189.title: BURN

1559637.title: Dracula in Space
1559637.overview: When the deep‑space vessel Orpheus discovers a centuries‑old derelict drifting at the edge of a black hole, the crew retrieves a sealed sarcophagus from its ruins. Soon after, crew members begin to disappear. Something ancient has awakened in the void - Dracula himself, exiled to the stars and hungry after centuries of confinement.

1562901.title: Big Little Things
1562901.overview: A seemingly perfect middle-class Chinese family faces an unprecedented situation when Lei brings a man home on NYE to pretend to be her boyfriend. Her same-sex girlfriend's unexpected visit intertwined her with a real intimacy crisis.

1568597.title: Hélène Trésore Transnationale
1568597.overview: In this intimate portrait addressed directly to Hélène Hazera, filmmaker Judith Abitbol revisits a key figure of France’s countercultures from the late 1960s to the 1990s. A member of the Gazolines and the FHAR (Homosexual Front for Revolutionary Action), Hazera was a tireless LGBTQ activist who founded Act Up’s Trans and AIDS commissions—one of her proudest achievements. Her true victory, however, was becoming the first transgender journalist at a major national newspaper (Libération), and later a producer at Radio France and France TV. Through her story, Abitbol reconnects with the insurrectionary spirit and creative chaos of those decades—an era when French culture was shaken by radical imagination, humor, and defiance. The film celebrates these modern Antigones who dared to live their desires beyond the reach of any law.

1570517.title: Backyard Sports: The Animated Special
1570517.overview: It’s Opening Day at Steele Stadium. But team superstar Stephanie ‘Bubbles’ Morgan is in crisis. She’s lost her gotta-have-it, never-play-without-it lucky bubble gum! With just 30 minutes until game time, the Backyard kids embark on a wild mission to track it down and save their season.

1578645.title: Doorman

1579093.title: Hamletmachine

1590677.trailerName: Putri, Stop Wandering Around - Teaser Trailer | November 5, 2026 in Theaters

1600149.title: Drax

1600661.title: Velvet Fire
1600661.overview: Silvana, a young trans woman, faces the gradual collapse of her relationship while carrying a wound that shapes her present: the belief that she cannot be loved. Amid confusion, jealousy, and the urge to hold on to what is falling apart, she receives news that forces her to confront her family past. Along the way, Silvana must choose the life she wants to build and whether she can break free from the idea that she is destined for loneliness.

1604245.title: Will You Come Find Me?

1610901.trailerName: Aag Lagay Basti Mein | Official Trailer | Fahad Mustafa & Mahira Khan | This Eid

As suspicion shifts from one person to another, two brothers, Leo and Elias, find themselves at the center of a mystery that will test their loyalty and force them to confront the truth. A digital elegy on forgiveness, abandonment, and the violent silence of goodbye.

1746965.title: Changing Room

Ayoub is not ready.

The event took place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States - right after Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide's Ola de Calor event in the same venue.

1751701.title: After Impact
1751701.overview: After losing his father, Ethan Nichols inherits one of the largest greenhouses in the country, just as the world faces a devastating threat from an approaching asteroid. As society begins to unravel, Ethan grapples with personal betrayal, overwhelming loneliness, and the growing fear that survival may come at the cost of his humanity. Seeking refuge in his family’s bunker, Ethan endures the harsh aftermath of the impact, wrestling with physical injury and emotional despair. When a faint voice crackles over his radio, Ethan discovers he's not as alone as he believed.

1752661.title: Wallander - Steget efter

1759125.title: La Noche del mediodía

Cut off from communication and without the tools to confront the reality before them, the residents gather in the town square to discuss alternatives. As uncertainty grows, the community plunges into a conflict where reason and barbarity blur and intertwine in a jumble of scientific, conspiratorial, and divine theories. Meanwhile, the dawn of a new day seems to depend solely on what they choose to believe in together.

1760149.title: Azem 6: Mühür

With her arrival, the dark past that the village has silently hidden for so long awakens, and the curse thought to be forgotten begins to manifest itself. But the truth awaiting Ceren is far more shocking. Learning that she is the one they have been waiting for all these years, the young woman is drawn into the center of supernatural events that will change the fate of the town, along with an ancient seal that appears on her body. In this struggle surrounded by secrets from the past, curses that have lasted for generations, and unseen forces, Ceren must confront both her own destiny and the darkness that has held the village captive for centuries.

1764501.title: Yves Saint Laurent: The Hamish Bowles Collection
1764501.overview: Yves Saint Laurent: The Hamish Bowles Collection is a documentary revealing the curation of 55 rare, personal YSL garments by Vogue editor-at-large Hamish Bowles. Showcased at the Musée Yves Saint Laurent Marrakech, the film highlights iconic designs from the 1960s to 1990s, focusing on the "lived history" of pieces once worn by fashion figures like Nan Kempner and Betty Catroux, showcasing the designer's genius. This documentary offers a glimpse into the exhibition, with interviews by Hamish Bowles, Madison Cox, Patrick Kinmonth, Zerlina Hughes and Marisa Berenson.
1764501.original_title: Yves Saint Laurent: The Hamish Bowles Collection

1766421.title: Blood Money
1766421.overview: In the Albanian port city of Durrës, Arion, a former inmate, is released from prison to fight in illegal bare-knuckle bouts at the notorious venue «The Circle» on behalf of Ilir, who is heavily in debt. Club owner Hans is initially skeptical of Arion. However, as Arion attracts more and more attention, Hans recognizes his commercial potential as well. What begins as a way out of poverty turns into a risky game when Ilir becomes involved in an illegal betting ring.

1766997.title: Mighty Mary
1766997.overview: Mighty Mary chronicles an amazing group of “we eat nails for breakfast” type of women: the first all-women’s sailing team to contend for the famed America’s Cup, the holy grail for one of sport’s most elite and exclusive racing events.  This team was groundbreaking, beginning with an advertisement in the New York Times.  From there, a group of world class and Olympic sailors as well as Olympic rowers came together, a team which included a deaf sailor, a Native Hawaiian sailor, and the first African American sailor to ever win an America’s Cup race (as a coach of this novice, erstwhile team).  What was dismissed as a publicity stunt turned into something unimaginable. This motley crew (sailing aboard Mighty Mary) stunningly eliminated Stars & Stripes from contention. However, a secret backroom deal the night before the race upended that result. This is a true underdog story about a team which reshaped what could be possible in a sport that had long been inaccessible.

1767445.title: Once Upon a Time in Seattle
1767445.overview: Comprised of moments from over 40 films shot in Seattle, and a few irresistible facsimiles, Once Upon a Time in Seattle is part love letter, part loony action adventure, and part free-associative meditation on the transience of landscape in a city that has always had a complicated relationship with honoring its past while moving swiftly into the future.
1767445.trailerName: Once Upon a Time in Seattle @ Northwest Film Forum, September 11 & 12
1767445.original_title: Once Upon a Time in Seattle

1768341.title: TEDE. Forever Rap
1768341.overview: TEDE. Forever Rap is an uncompromising portrait of Jacek "Tede" Graniecki – one of the most influential and controversial artists in the history of Polish rap. The film is driven by never-before-seen private archives from 1993–2002 – a priceless record of the years when hip-hop in Poland was just being born, with Tede and his crew at the very heart of that revolution. Twenty-two years after his first visit, the artist returns to the streets of New York on a sentimental journey, asking how he, Polish rap, Poland and America have changed.

1769941.title: Traços de Fuga
1769941.overview: Diana retreats into drawing and music to escape the chaos of her home. Each page of her notebook becomes an extension of the emotions she cannot bring herself to say out loud. But when even the smallest moments of peace are interrupted, Diana realizes that mentally escaping may no longer be enough to cope with the reality she lives in.

1770005.title: As You Were
1770005.overview: In this loose homage to Steve Martin's "L.A. Story", Harris is a young man figuring his life out in New York City. Muddled relationships and struggles with commitment and change leave Harris confused and stuck in an unhappy status quo, struggling to figure out which direction to take his life. Through the help of new connections and New York City itself speaking to him, Harris is able to start to change his life for the better.

1771669.title: Io sono Felice

1771989.title: Mitti De Putt

For one young man, the feud stops being history the day his uncle murders his grandparents and carries his mother away. Left with nothing but the land beneath his feet and the promise he makes on it, he sets out to answer blood with blood. To bring his mother home, he must first confront the man who took her, and the price the soil demands is heavier than he knows.

1772629.title: Pequeño diccionario de gramática de las nubes

1772629.original_title: Pequeño diccionario de gramática de las nubes
